title: Rollcall owners check
description: What `rollcall owners --format=json` prints: the latest scan checked against the owners file. Internal: it names apps. The command exits 1 while `owner_unknown` is above 0.

unowned.description: The scanned apps no entry lists ("no owner on file"), in scan order

confirm_days.description: ROLLCALL_OWNERS_CONFIRM_DAYS: how long a "confirmed" date counts. 0 turns the check off

unconfirmed.description: The scanned apps an entry lists, but no entry that lists them was confirmed within confirm_days (a date after today is not trusted), in scan order. Their owner is unknown until someone confirms

last_confirmed.description: The latest trusted confirmation of any entry that lists the app, or null when none was ever recorded

owner_unknown.description: How many scanned apps have an unknown owner: unowned plus unconfirmed
